locator.text: Display 141.5, p. 141, in the proof of Lemma A.8

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean uses a different formula here. The displayed chain is the Fubini exchange that converts the tail pressure identity into a radial moment: with p(r) = -∫_r^∞ u_θ(r')^2 dr'/r', swapping the order of the two integrals gives the inner ∫_0^{r'} r dr = r'^2/2 and hence -½∫_0^∞ r' u_θ(r')^2 dr'. The same algebraic identity (radial pressure moment = -½ times the next moment of the pressure derivative) is stated by `IntegratedMeanBalances.pressure_moment`, but over all of ℝ for a compactly supported smooth p inside the Section 8 mean-balance machinery; I found no use of it, or of any Fubini exchange, in the Lemma A.8 / terminal-stress chain. There Lean never forms ∫_0^∞ r p(r) dr at all: `TerminalStress.canonicalPressure` and `HeatedOutgoing.Pi` take the tail integral as the definition of the pressure and the argument proceeds pointwise in the similarity variable, so the exchange step as written is not reproduced. Searches for a nested `∫ x in Ioi 0, ∫ …` and for `Fubini` in these files returned nothing (Fubini appears only in the R3/Fourier files). Low: the identity is elementary and the surrounding result is reached without it.
